provenance.construction: error-detecting CSS code (H_X = H_Z = the all-ones row on 6 qubits; reproduced from the Error Correction Zoo entry stab_6_4_2, https://errorcorrectionzoo.org/c/stab_6_4_2)
provenance.notes: Reproduced from the Error Correction Zoo entry stab_6_4_2 (https://errorcorrectionzoo.org/c/stab_6_4_2); gate found no exact or WL-equivalent board entry.

contributed_by.method: Simulated annealing over site assignments on an integer grid with the repo's own research/local2d/fold_layout.search_layout (max-diameter objective, several bounding boxes and seeds); single layer at radius 4 tried first, then two layers at 7. Radius and per-site occupancy re-measured with the verifier's rule.

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil + 4 span flags sequential extraction (max_flags=3 per check, 6 X + 6 Z edge-colored data CX layers per round, coloring candidate 0); generated by qldpc submit (research/circuit_autogen.py, seed 0), the first of up to 6 candidates whose RIS screen at 2 rounds found nothing below d; witnesses from RIS on ker(H_dem) at twice the gate's trial budget, validated in GF(2)

contributed_by.method: circuit_autogen schedule search (two-block interleaved, then layout, then generic), verified by verify/circuit_verify.py before writing
